description: Phase 3E. Exercises the WASM transport-slot end-to-end activation lifecycle and the locked-at-3E resource caps. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate so transport_module routes are selectable. Day 3 the rig drives a soak-only WASM module load (slug `hello-https`, sha256 prefix `a1b2c3d4`); diagnostics MUST surface the slug + sha256_prefix in `loaded_wasm_modules`. Day 7 the rig records 100 successful dial outcomes; `last_wasm_module_dial_outcome` MUST be `ok`. Day 10 the rig drives a deliberately-too-much-fuel module load and a dial against it; the outcome MUST be `fuel_exhausted`; the runaway module MUST be unloaded; `wasm_kill_switched_count` MUST NOT increment (fuel exhaustion is not a kill-switch). Day 14 the rig clears all loaded modules; `loaded_wasm_modules` MUST clear to `[]`. The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
